card.name: Noun after a modifier: reflex, bleed, dinner
card.fires_on: The noun right after a modifying word in a set phrase, mainly 'reflex' after 'loss of righting' or 'gagging', and 'bleed' or 'bleeding' after 'withdrawal'. Also 'dinner' or 'speech' after 'welcome', 'farewell' or 'victory'.
